gloss: to imprint; to instill; to rub in

definitions.explanation: To deeply embed ideas, beliefs, or behaviors through repeated exposure or conditioning, especially during formative periods.

definitions.gloss: to rub in; to work into
definitions.explanation: To physically rub something into a surface so it penetrates or absorbs.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{良|よ}い{習慣|しゅうかん}を{刷|す}り{込|こ}む。
{幼|おさな}い{頃|ころ}に{刷|す}り{込|こ}まれた{価値観|かちかん}。
ひな{鳥|どり}は{最初|さいしょ}に{見|み}たものを{親|おや}だと{刷|す}り{込|こ}まれる。
examples.english: Baby birds are imprinted to see the first thing they see as their parent.

examples.japanese: クリームを{肌|はだ}に{刷|す}り{込|こ}む。
examples.english: Rub the cream into your skin.

examples.japanese: ワックスを{床|ゆか}に{刷|す}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I rubbed wax into the floor.

examples.japanese: {下味|したあじ}を{肉|にく}に{刷|す}り{込|こ}む。
examples.english: Rub the seasoning into the meat.

notes:
{刷|す}り{込|こ}む has psychological and physical meanings.

SENSE 1 - PSYCHOLOGICAL:
- {刷|す}り{込|こ}み: imprinting (psychology term)
- {価値観|かちかん}を{刷|す}り{込|こ}む: to instill values
- {刷|す}り{込|こ}まれる: to be conditioned/imprinted

IMPRINTING (psychology):
The term {刷|す}り{込|こ}み is used in Japanese psychology for "imprinting," the phenomenon where young animals form attachments during critical periods.

SENSE 2 - PHYSICAL:
- クリームを{刷|す}り{込|こ}む: to rub in cream
- {調味料|ちょうみりょう}を{刷|す}り{込|こ}む: to rub in seasonings
